comment: Feed registry. type=gnews builds a Google News RSS search URL from `query`. type=rss fetches `url` directly. sector is the default sector tag for items from that feed.

feeds.name: GN-BFSI-appointments
feeds.query: (appoints OR appointed OR names OR named) (CEO OR "managing director" OR CFO OR CTO OR COO OR CHRO OR "executive director") (bank OR banking OR insurance OR NBFC OR "mutual fund" OR fintech OR "asset management" OR AMC)

feeds.name: GN-BFSI-exits
feeds.query: ("steps down" OR resigns OR resigned OR retires OR quits) (CEO OR MD OR CFO OR "managing director" OR chairman) (bank OR insurance OR NBFC OR fintech)

feeds.name: GN-BFSI-promotions
feeds.query: (elevated OR promoted OR reappointed OR "re-appointed" OR "extension") (bank OR insurance OR NBFC OR fintech OR AMC) (CEO OR MD OR "managing director" OR "executive director" OR "deputy managing director")

feeds.name: GN-BFSI-regulatory
feeds.query: ("RBI approves" OR "IRDAI approves" OR "SEBI approves") appointment

feeds.name: GN-EDU-vc
